zh-CN.name: 确定性进度条
zh-CN.description: 已知工作量时显示真实完成比例。本演示的数值由滑块模拟。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 进度条从 0 过渡到 {progress}%，持续 {duration_ms}ms，使用 {easing} 缓动。实际产品应由真实任务进度更新；减少动态效果时直接显示最终比例。

en.name: Determinate Progress
en.description: Show a real completion ratio when total work is known. This demo simulates it with a slider.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Animate the progress bar from 0 to {progress}% over {duration_ms}ms with {easing} easing. In production, bind it to actual task progress. Show the final value directly for reduced motion.

sources.note: 原创概念说明与演示；参数为本项目示例，非标准值。
概念或实现参考，未复制外部正文与组件代码。
